_doc: Every agent runs on the model its tool is already on: the person starts the session on the model they want
(flash to start up: flash it is), and every role and headless run uses that one. No role names a model; a
role only sets its thinking level (`effort:` in .agents/agents/<role>/agent.md, where the tool has one).
A quota, usage or rate limit stops a headless run (make fleet-next, make fleet-dispatch) and says when the
model is back. Only with FALLBACK=1 do they go down the chains below: the first model that is installed,
offered by its CLI and not out of quota; a model that hits a limit rests until its reset
(target/fleet/models.json) and the next one takes over, in any tool. `make fleet-models` shows them.
tools: the order tools are tried in (AGENT=<tool> puts that one first). chain: that tool's models for
FALLBACK=1, best first; null = the tool's own default model. agy also uses any other model `agy models` lists.
opencode: chain [null] = the model opencode has selected (cloud or local). On a local model nothing ever starts subagents.
